description: Dept. of Local Government - NWP Notice Under Section 66C (4) Appointed Chairman and Vice Chirman to the 02 L.G. Institutions
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the appointment of elected officials (Chairman and Vice Chairman) for Local Government Institutes following elections, as authorized by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It contains election results and declarations for specific local government bodies, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
